inlineCodeColorDesc.zh: 跟随当前颜色卡，或恢复 Claude 0.19.7 的暖色；自定义颜色卡优先。
inlineCodeColorDesc.en: Follow the active colour card or restore Claude 0.19.7's warm ink; the custom card takes precedence.

inlineCodeColorRequired.zh: 跟随宿主配色时由宿主决定行内代码字色。
inlineCodeColorRequired.en: The host owns inline-code colour while its palette is selected.
